charts.title: K2-174 b: orbits around K2-174
charts.description: The orbits of K2-174's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-174 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Livingston et al. 2019 (2019AJ....157..102L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LIVINGSTON_ET_AL__2019): P 19.562307 d

charts.title: K2-174 b: its transit
charts.description: K2-174 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (43, 44, 71) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 243014114, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 8 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 48 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 23-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 8 min late; 23-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 16 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
